exact_applications.statement: For a smooth closed real (1,1) form gamma, AM_gamma extends via decreasing approximation to a d1-continuous functional E1 -> R, bounded on d1-bounded subsets.
exact_applications.domain_check: Our X is connected smooth compact Kahler and every slice is in E1. gamma is smooth closed; no projectivity.

exact_applications.unit: Proposition 4.5, only smooth positive twisting form
exact_applications.statement: For smooth closed positive gamma (taking beta=gamma,f=0 in condition (3)), AM_gamma is convex along bounded-Laplacian weak geodesic segments.
exact_applications.domain_check: Used for smooth endpoint approximants. Extension to finite-energy segments is proved in the paper using granted R decreasing geodesics and Proposition 4.4. The bounded source statement is not silently applied to unbounded endpoints.

exact_applications.statement: The formula for extended untwisted Mabuchi is the greatest d1-lower-semicontinuous extension to E1, and it is convex along finite-energy E1 geodesics.
exact_applications.domain_check: Twist zero satisfies (3) with beta=0,f=0. Only lower semicontinuity/convexity is used; no entropy continuity asserted.

primary.coordinate_conversion: BDL potential v=u/(2pi), same omega. Currents/probability measures coincide; d1_BDL=d1/(2pi), AM(v)=E(u)/(2pi), T_gamma(u)=2pi*n*AM_gamma(v). Ric_BDL=2pi Ric, scalar_BDL=2pi scalar, so K_BDL(v)=H(u)+T_{-Ric}(u)+scalar*E(u) exactly.
primary.not_claimed: No complete recursive primary reproof or whole-PDF reading; ordinary finite-energy background is the explicit caller R premise where invoked. No singular-current or family application.
